title: This FREE AI Builds Your Entire Business 🤯 #shorts  #ai #chatgpt #coding #aitutorial
description:
🚀 What if you could describe your business and AI builds the entire website for you?

I use it to create a restaurant-style business experience with landing pages, menus, food cards, reservation forms, locations, AI-generated images, and interactive sections — all from a simple AI prompt.
